core_components: hash-chained fsync'd JSONL journal with lock and torn-tail recovery
commit-blob capsule builder with residency nonce and fail-closed secret scan
patch escrow with temp-index apply check
fenced, fast-forward-only epoch guard with reviewer independence
protocol_changes: model-facing kinds reduced to ASK, REVIEW, IMPACT, PROPOSE_PATCH
FLUSH, HELLO, ROUTE, DISAGREE removed as messages; admin ops become switchboard verbs
basis stamped at dispatch and arrival; stale_on_arrival
anchors carry literal quotes; citation classes VERIFIED/LOCATED/UNANCHORED/INVALID
artifacts passed by value so they can be policy-scanned
UNKNOWN_TERMINAL on recovery; LATE_RESULT for cost
lifecycle_mechanism: Capsule built from commit blobs -> boot (FORK if verified, else PREFIX; APPEND only for E1-P) -> calibrate (nonce + negative probe + regex-graded suite) -> READY | QUARANTINED. In-domain epoch -> blue/green rebuild + recalibrate before route flip. Flush is a no-op in FORK/PREFIX and equals rotation in APPEND. Switchboard restart -> UNKNOWN_TERMINAL for in-flight requests, nodes DETACHED until residency re-verified.
code_writing_policy: Regime W by default (worker writes, Elephant advises). Regime P opt-in: Elephant diff is escrowed data, validated against allowlist and protected paths, apply-checked on a temporary index, applied only by the worker, reviewed by a non-author non-Elephant, integrated fast-forward under a fenced lease. Regime R excluded from v0.2.
security_boundaries: capsules from committed blobs only; path denylist; symlink/binary exclusion; secret hit aborts build
request payload secret scan -> POLICY_DENIED, no bypass retry
artifacts rendered as quoted untrusted data
unknown response fields stripped and reported, never executed
read-only enforced by OS/harness, verified before admission
Elephants cannot originate requests or review commits
